name: sprite_builder_codespace_clone
description: Clone a repo into the codespace's /workspace/app using the owner's GitHub token. REPLACES whatever is there. Defaults to the codespace's project repo + branch; override with repo_full_name and/or branch. Codespace must be 'ready'.

codespace_id.description: The codespace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_codespace / sprite_builder_list_codespaces).

repo_full_name.description: Optional repo to clone (owner/repo). Defaults to the project's repo.

branch.description: Optional branch to check out. Defaults to the codespace's branch.
